nodes.label: UI Definitive Standard (Google Stitch / Linear / Figma)
nodes.rationale: User brief (L1): raise Cadenza's interface to the definitive Google Stitch / Linear / Figma standard and remove any residue of prototype or 'AI slop'. Six design blocks (S1-S6) replace prior prototype-era requirements.
nodes.norm_label: ui definitive standard (google stitch / linear / figma)

nodes.label: S1 Navbar Segmented Pill Control (amended by L2 to static view label)
nodes.rationale: The centre pill keeps its solid sharp surface and ambient underglow aura, but a one-item switcher would be a dead control, so L2 turned it into a static non-interactive view label (data-active=true, cursor default).
nodes.norm_label: s1 navbar segmented pill control (amended by l2 to static view label)

nodes.label: S2 Continuous Narrative Swimlanes
nodes.rationale: Lanes must read as one continuous corridor separated only by a hairline border-b, and each left lane header must match the exact height/position of the lane its scenes travel in.

nodes.label: S3 Scene Card Anatomy (no stacked hero numerals)
nodes.rationale: The giant transparent 01/02/03 background numerals are removed; the order becomes a 20px circular badge, and the thread colour becomes a rim light integrated into the card base instead of a halo.
nodes.norm_label: s3 scene card anatomy (no stacked hero numerals)

nodes.label: S4 Vector Causal Connectors (Bézier wires from 6px ports)
nodes.rationale: Wires leave discrete circular ports on the lateral card edges, stroke clean at 1.5px cyan with no dash, and carry a small directional arrow toward the destination node.
nodes.norm_label: s4 vector causal connectors (bezier wires from 6px ports)

nodes.label: S5 Manuscript Binder Side Panel
nodes.rationale: Binder/Estructura/Metas tabs reuse the navbar pill control; only the selected list card gets a sharp 1px cyan border and the 'Nueva Escena' action stays a quiet flat pill.

nodes.label: S6 Typography and Global Design Tokens
nodes.rationale: Geist/Inter interface font, antialiased font smoothing, Lucide icons fixed at 14px strokeWidth 1.5, zero emojis, palette background #090A0F / surfaces #12141D / borders border-white/10.
nodes.norm_label: s6 typography and global design tokens

nodes.label: Decision: canvas geometry stays as drawing primitives
nodes.rationale: The canvas is a 2D Canvas renderer, not DOM, so Tailwind sketches become drawing primitives. TRACK_HEIGHT=112, TRACK_GAP=16, CARD_HEIGHT=96 and PORT_RADIUS=4 stay unchanged because they are pinned by tests; continuous swimlanes are achieved by painting each band as TRACK_HEIGHT+TRACK_GAP with a 1px bottom rule.
nodes.norm_label: decision: canvas geometry stays as drawing primitives

nodes.label: Decision: pl-8 breathing margin as initial panX = 32
nodes.rationale: Implemented as the initial/reset viewport panX = 32 rather than changing getSceneRect, because the scene-rect equation is asserted verbatim by the suite.
nodes.norm_label: decision: pl-8 breathing margin as initial panx = 32

nodes.label: Decision L2: Red Orbital view and RadialConstellation removed
nodes.rationale: User L2 supersedes the earlier re-introduction: the Red Orbital tab, centerView state, RadialConstellation render branch and constellation component are all removed, leaving the navbar centre as a static label.
nodes.norm_label: decision l2: red orbital view and radialconstellation removed
